meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为协调者扫描项目，找出未使用的导入、变量、函数和类型，用 LSP 验证确认无用后，把删除任务分派给多个并行代理执行，并自动运行类型检查、测试和构建验证，最后逐批提交改动。
howto.when: 当你说出 “remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup” 等关键词，或要求清理未使用的代码时触发。

say.text: 请清理这个项目里未使用的代码。
say.note: Claude 会启动扫描和删除流程。

say.text: 只清理 src/hooks 目录下的死代码。
say.note: 它会在指定范围内扫描。

say.text: 把 src/foo.ts 里没用的函数找出来删掉。
say.note: Claude 会验证后只改那个文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as orchestrator: scans for unused imports, variables, functions and types, verifies with LSP, delegates removal to parallel agents, then runs typecheck, tests, build, and commits each batch atomically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords such as "remove dead code", "dead code", "cleanup", or ask to clean up unused code.

say_en.text: Please clean up unused code in this project.
say_en.note: Claude will start scanning and removing.

say_en.text: Only clean dead code in the src/hooks directory.
say_en.note: It will scan only that scope.

say_en.text: Find and remove unused functions in src/foo.ts.
say_en.note: Claude will verify and edit only that file.
